sloka: वन्दित्वा चरणौ रामः विसम्ज्ञस्य पितुस् तदा ।कैकेय्याः च अपि अनार्याया निष्पपात महा द्युतिः ॥२-१९-२८॥
transliteration: vanditvā caraṇau rāmaḥ visamjñasya pitus tadā ।kaikeyyāḥ ca api anāryāyā niṣpapāta mahā dyutiḥ ॥2-19-28॥

translations.english: Effulgent Rama bowed at the feet of his father who had fallen into a swoon. He bowed at the feet of the ignoble Kaikeyi and set out.
